correctness.rationale: Full n-dimensional norm normalization follows from the unitary DFT. The exact frame operator is I+P_T-Q_B, and its four nontrivial spectral values follow from a two-dimensional principal-angle reduction and a directly computed two-by-two Fourier cross-Gram. Optimizing the cosine modulus over integer residues proves global sharpness, while divisor and totient enumeration proves each count. The proof treats n=4 and singular cases. Direct-matrix checks from the provided script corroborate 129,994 finite cases but are not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: At a fixed critical budget of n independent complex samples, replacing one missed Fourier value by one time sample has no placement-dependent design. Replacing two introduces the first genuine placement and aliasing optimization. The exact all-n lower frame bounds, every equality case, composite-modulus singularity count, and parity-dependent asymptotics provide a complete natural stability-design classification and sharp worst-case noise amplification, beyond generic uniqueness or numerical conditioning comparisons.
